Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly changed Giuseppe Cesari’s death year from the previously verified 1640 to 1610, reducing his lifespan from 72 to 42 years. This miscopying/miscalculation contradicted earlier gathered evidence (WebSurfer showed 1568–1640) and led to the wrong conclusion that Nicos Poulantzas (1936–1979, 43 years) lived longer.
